snippet.title: Dino Domino - Official Playtest Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026
snippet.description: Check out gameplay from Dino Domino, a pixel-art puzzle game where you can rewrite the rules. Swap commands to create: healing from traps, Medusa petrification, infinite fireball loops?! Play as an adorable little dinosaur on a mind-bending adventure to save the world! Dino Domino will be available on PC. A playtest is out now on Steam.
